# CPDataKit v0.9.1

2026-09-22

CPDataKit v0.9.1 is a maintenance release for schema-upload errors, pandas compatibility
and CI reliability. The Chinese workbench and readable offline HTML reports were introduced
in v0.9.0 and remain available.

## Changes

- Schema-upload failures return a fixed error message instead of internal exception details.
  Regression tests cover invalid-upload cleanup and a subsequent valid upload.
- The pandas requirement is now `>=2.2,<4`. Compatibility validation includes pandas 2.2.2,
  2.2.3 and 3.0.6; installed-distribution metadata tests check the supported version boundaries.
- Both CodeQL init/analyze actions are pinned to the same v4.38.0 revision.
- The active-job test fixture waits for an explicit release event, so slow catalog writes
  cannot end the artificial long-running job before the visibility and cancellation assertions.
  Existing product assertions and cleanup remain in place.

These changes were reviewed in [#45](https://github.com/koocmitwho/cpdatakit/pull/45),
[#42](https://github.com/koocmitwho/cpdatakit/pull/42) and
[#43](https://github.com/koocmitwho/cpdatakit/pull/43).

## Compatibility

Python 3.12 or newer is required. Existing public Python/CLI interfaces, schema 1.0 and 2.0,
CPDataKit HDF5 1.0 and 2.0, and numerical/unit semantics are unchanged.
Validation continues to check declared data rules; it does not establish physical equivalence
or experimental validity.

## Get started

```bash
python -m pip install --upgrade "cpdatakit==0.9.1"
cpdatakit ui
```

See the [workbench guide](https://github.com/koocmitwho/cpdatakit/blob/v0.9.1/docs/workbench-guide.md)
and [quickstart](https://github.com/koocmitwho/cpdatakit/blob/v0.9.1/docs/quickstart.md).
